name: Field Notes
author: Sweepercom
description: A naturalist's expedition journal in warm parchment tones: a page-turn loading sequence, a compass-rose hero, stamped and taped paper panels, and specimen-tag character cards.

components.name: Parchment backdrop
components.blurb: The warm paper page background, its grain texture, and the default ink text colour.

components.name: Profile layout & identity
components.blurb: The grid the hero, panels and credit are placed on, plus the username, follower count and badges. Includes its tablet and mobile layout.

components.name: Journal-opening sequence
components.blurb: The opening cover-swing screen with a spinning compass needle.

components.name: Expedition cover hero
components.blurb: The compass-rose journal cover, title treatment, wax stamp and optional portrait slot.

components.name: Journal content panels
components.blurb: The status log, section tabs, field report, specimen notes accordion, and correspondence links.

components.name: Header, menus and controls
components.blurb: The site header, mobile navigation, user menu, notifications, and follow controls.

components.name: Specimen character gallery
components.blurb: The character heading, tagged specimen cards, filters, and pagination treatment.

components.name: Template credit
components.blurb: A subtle typewritten credit line at the base of the profile.

assets.label: Optional cut-out hero portrait
assets.placement: Add an img with class fn-hero-art inside the fn-hero element

notes: The loading cover-swing is decorative and never receives pointer events.
Animations are disabled for visitors who prefer reduced motion.
No CSS background images or custom properties are used.
The character sort control uses the durable react-select__control hook instead of its generated Emotion class.
Every component carries its own responsive and reduced-motion rules, so parts can be added or removed independently.
